 * ATF-Test «ITAM: Lifecycle-Status Hardware-Asset», Schritt «Run Server Side Script» (Jasmine 3.1).
 * Prüft die Business Rule servicenow/business_rule_asset_lifecycle.js und das
 * Standardverhalten der Plattform, auf das der Flow «Laptop anfordern» baut.
 * ATF setzt alle Änderungen nach dem Testlauf zurück (Rollback).
 */
(function (outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual) {
    var IN_USE = '1';
    var IN_STOCK = '6';
    var RETIRED = '7';

    function newComputerCi(name, status) {
        var ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_computer');
        ci.initialize();
        ci.setValue('name', name);
        ci.setValue('install_status', status);
        return ci.insert();
    }

    function newAssetFor(ciId) {
        // So legt ServiceNow Assets aus CIs an: immer zuerst «In use»
        var asset = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        asset.initialize();
        asset.setValue('ci', ciId);
        asset.setValue('install_status', IN_USE);
        return asset.insert();
    }

    function load(id) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
        gr.get(id);
        return gr;
    }

    function adminId() {
        var user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        user.get('user_name', 'admin');
        return user.getUniqueValue();
    }

    describe('Business Rule «ITAM: Lifecycle-Status Hardware-Asset»', function () {
        it('übernimmt beim Anlegen den Status «In Stock» vom CI', function () {
            var asset = load(newAssetFor(newComputerCi('ATF-NB-LAGER', IN_STOCK)));
            expect(asset.getValue('install_status')).toBe(IN_STOCK);
            expect(asset.getValue('substatus')).toBe('available');
        });

        it('übernimmt beim Anlegen den Status «Retired» vom CI', function () {
            var asset = load(newAssetFor(newComputerCi('ATF-NB-ALT', RETIRED)));
            expect(asset.getValue('install_status')).toBe(RETIRED);
        });

        it('setzt bei der Zuweisung aus dem Lager das Zuweisungsdatum und leert den Unterstatus', function () {
            var asset = load(newAssetFor(newComputerCi('ATF-NB-NEU', IN_STOCK)));
            asset.setValue('install_status', IN_USE);
            asset.setValue('assigned_to', adminId());
            asset.update();
            asset = load(asset.getUniqueValue());
            expect(asset.getValue('install_status')).toBe(IN_USE);
            expect(asset.getValue('assigned_to')).toBe(adminId());
            expect(asset.assigned.nil()).toBe(false);
            expect(asset.substatus.nil()).toBe(true);
        });
    });

    describe('Standardverhalten der Plattform (Grundlage für den Flow)', function () {
        it('löscht die Zuweisung, solange ein Gerät im Lager ist', function () {
            var asset = load(newAssetFor(newComputerCi('ATF-NB-ZUWEISUNG', IN_STOCK)));
            asset.setValue('assigned_to', adminId());
            asset.update();
            asset = load(asset.getUniqueValue());
            expect(asset.getValue('install_status')).toBe(IN_STOCK);
            expect(asset.assigned_to.nil()).toBe(true);
        });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

jasmine.getEnv().execute();

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>alm_hardware</collection><condition>current.operation() == 'insert' || current.install_status.changes()</condition><description>Lifecycle-Konsistenz der Hardware-Assets (Portfolio-Projekt ITAM Demo)</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>ITAM: Lifecycle-Status Hardware-Asset</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Business Rule «ITAM: Lifecycle-Status Hardware-Asset»
 * Tabelle: alm_hardware · when: before · insert und update · Reihenfolge 100
 * Bedingung: current.operation() == 'insert' || current.install_status.changes()
 *
 * Ergänzt die Standardregeln der Plattform auf alm_asset, statt sie zu doppeln:
 * - «Clear Assigned To on update»: Lager, Bestellung, Transport -> Zuweisung wird gelöscht.
 *   Wer ein Gerät aus dem Lager zuweist, setzt darum Status «In use» und Person
 *   gemeinsam (so macht es der Flow «Laptop anfordern»).
 * - «Asset Retirement»: Ausmusterung -> Datum, Zuweisung und Lagerort werden gelöscht.
 *
 * Was fehlt und diese Regel ergänzt:
 * 1. Neues Asset aus einem CI (Job «Asset – Create asset delayed sync»):
 *    Lifecycle-Status vom CI übernehmen. Ohne diese Regel legt ServiceNow jedes
 *    Asset als «In use» an, auch für CIs, die «In Stock» oder «Retired» sind
 *    (Endlauf Meilenstein 1: 61 von 197 Assets mit falschem Status).
 * 2. Asset geht in Betrieb: Zeitpunkt der Zuweisung festhalten, Unterstatus leeren.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    var IN_USE = '1';
    var IN_MAINTENANCE = '3';
    var IN_STOCK = '6';
    var RETIRED = '7';
    // install_status cmdb_ci -> alm_asset; für diese vier Zustände sind die Werte gleich
    var FROM_CI = {'1': IN_USE, '3': IN_MAINTENANCE, '6': IN_STOCK, '7': RETIRED};

    if (current.operation() == 'insert') {
        if (!current.ci.nil()) {
            var ciStatus = current.ci.install_status.toString();
            if (FROM_CI[ciStatus] && FROM_CI[ciStatus] != current.getValue('install_status')) {
                current.setValue('install_status', FROM_CI[ciStatus]);
                current.setValue('substatus', ciStatus == IN_STOCK ? 'available' : '');
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    if (current.getValue('install_status') == IN_USE && !current.assigned_to.nil()) {
        current.setValue('substatus', '');
        if (current.assigned_to.changes() || current.assigned.nil()) {
            current.setValue('assigned', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        }
    }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 07:07:23</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0ac3aa64c3a4171015b012d4e4013199</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ITAM: Lifecycle-Status Hardware-Asset</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_0ac3aa64c3a4171015b012d4e4013199</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 07:26:25</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=0ac3aa64c3a4171015b012d4e4013199"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>Einmalig: Assets der Muster AG an den CI-Status angleichen</description><name>ITAM: Asset-Status an CI angleichen</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Fix Script «ITAM: Asset-Status an CI angleichen» (einmalig, als admin).
 *
 * Gleicht den Lifecycle-Status der Assets der Muster AG an ihr CI an. Nötig für
 * Assets, die vor der Business Rule «ITAM: Lifecycle-Status Hardware-Asset»
 * entstanden sind: ServiceNow hatte sie alle als «In use» angelegt.
 * setWorkflow(false): keine Business Rules, keine Rücksynchronisation aufs CI;
 * die CIs und damit die Messung der Datenqualität bleiben unverändert.
 */
var FROM_CI = {'1': '1', '3': '3', '6': '6', '7': '7'};
var gr = new GlideRecord('alm_hardware');
gr.addQuery('ci.company.name', 'Muster AG');
gr.query();
var changed = 0;
while (gr.next()) {
    var ciStatus = gr.ci.install_status.toString();
    var target = FROM_CI[ciStatus];
    if (target && target != gr.getValue('install_status')) {
        gr.setValue('install_status', target);
        gr.setValue('substatus', ciStatus == '6' ? 'available' : '');
        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        gr.update();
        changed++;
    }
}
gs.info('ITAM Fix: ' + changed + ' Assets an den CI-Status angeglichen');
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 07:07:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>1ec366a4c3a4171015b012d4e40131f9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ITAM: Asset-Status an CI angleichen</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_1ec366a4c3a4171015b012d4e40131f9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 07:07:23</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>
